title: Late-Fee Floor and Resident Standing on the Home-Site Lease — Training Cases
content:
**Training note: the floor of a Home-Site Lease late fee**

The floor is the amount the percentage fee of a Home-Site Lease late fee is raised to. It turns on full months of tenancy since the move-in date and on whether any returned payment was posted on the lease in the trailing twenty-four calendar months.

**Rule.** The floor is 25.00 for a resident with at least 120 full months of tenancy and no returned payment on the lease in the trailing twenty-four calendar months; 30.00 for a resident with at least 60 but fewer than 120 full months of tenancy and no returned payment in that window; and the lot class's late-fee minimum otherwise.

| Full months of tenancy | Returned payment in the trailing 24 calendar months | Floor |
|---|---|---|
| 120 or more | none | 25.00 |
| 60 to 119 | none | 30.00 |
| fewer than 60 | none | the lot class's late-fee minimum |
| any | one or more | the lot class's late-fee minimum |

### Cases

1. *130 months, no returned payment in two years* — 25.00.
2. *Exactly 120 months, none* — 25.00. At 119 months — 30.00.
3. *Exactly 60 months, none* — 30.00. At 59 months — the lot class's late-fee minimum.
4. *200 months, one returned payment posted 20 months ago* — inside the 24-month window: the lot class's late-fee minimum.
5. *200 months, the only returned payment posted 26 months ago* — outside the window: 25.00.

*Hypothetical figure.* A percentage fee of 21.40 for a resident in case 1 is raised to 25.00.
